The evening, in three steps

  1. 1

    Sign in with WhatsApp

    A one-time code to your number. The table stays on it, so you can cancel from any phone.

  2. 2

    Choose the table

    Date, arrival, adults and children. Up to fifty adults; children are counted as seats too.

  3. 3

    Pay ₹500 and arrive on time

    The advance comes off the bill. The table is held for 10 minutes from your booking time, then released automatically.

The hold, exactly

Tables are kept for ten minutes from the booked arrival time. At the eleventh minute the seats go back to the floor and the booking closes — no call needed. If you are running late, ring 070227 71888 before the ten minutes are up and we will do what we can.

The ₹500 advance is not a fee. It is deducted from your final bill, and a cancelled booking is refunded at the counter.

Good to know

  • Mandi takes about 20 minutes from order to table.
  • Every dish is 100% halal.

  • Open every day, 12 PM to 11 PM.
